text:
Priya: FYI Pelorus onboarding - their reserved pool goes live tonight 23:30 UTC. Plan: 8xH100, initial quota 350k tokens/min. They said bursts up to 420k briefly. Need load plan + renewal check-in after soak.
Jonah: Noted. Suggest we stage traffic ramp: 10m shadow, 20m 40%, 40m 80%, then full for 2h. Any objections?
Devon: Runtime notes: autoscaler threshold defaults to 70% util. For this profile (many short calls) we should enable faster scale-out (30s) and keep scale-in at 3m. Also enable KV pre-warm for top endpoints.
Leo: (Pelorus) We want seamless handover from our canary to full traffic, and an ops contact for rollback. Also surface costs during the 6h promo.
Priya: I'll confirm cost window and renewal touchpoint. Internal ask: add a renewal note that if they hit sustained >80% quota within 30 days we'll schedule an expansion review.
Jonah: Loadtest tool: vegeta + replay of prod traces. I'll run initial shadow replay at 23:35 UTC. Cmd: `vegeta attack -rate=6000 -duration=10m | vegeta report`
Devon: Also will deploy a diagnostic trace header so we can attribute p99 to model vs routing. Header: `x-rw-diagnose: pelorus-23`
OpsBot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window for infra nodes at 01:00 UTC. Blocked: node reboot could affect scaling.
Priya: Can we reschedule node reboots to 02:30? Pelorus prefers no infra ops during their 6h test window.
Jonah: I can move reboots to 02:30. Patch window updated.
Devon: Canary fallback policy: if p99 >250ms AND CPU queue >200ms for 5m -> shift 30% new traffic to hosted-fallback-us-east. We'll automate the route but require manual confirm before full cutover.
Leo: Acknowledged. Also requesting a short enablement session after soak for their engineering leads. Prefer 1pm PST tomorrow.
Priya: Scheduling that now. I'll send invite to Leo+team and add a short doc: "Pelorus dedicated run notes".
Jonah: Load replay started. Quick logs: "replay 10m | rps ~5800 | errors 0 | p99 140ms"
Devon: 15m update: p99 170ms, kv hit 66%, H100 util 54%. Slight jitter on shard-7.
Jonah: Shard-7 hotness causing queue spikes; bumped shard count +1 at 23:48 UTC. Autoscale reacted ok.
Priya: Customer ping: "We're seeing expected behavior, good latency so far."
Leo: Pelorus: Confirmed, performance looks good. One ask: include a short cost breakdown in the post-mortem.
Priya: Will include estimated unit cost + projection for steady 300k tpm.
Devon: End of soak summary: 3h total, no fallback triggered, scaled to 9 GPUs at peak, average p99 158ms, max GPU util 78%. Actions: review shard-7 hashing, raise default pre-warm TTL to 12h for similar accounts.
Jonah: Filing follow-ups: ticket CS-4721 (renewal touch + cost deck), RTE-889 (hot-shard mitigation).
Priya: Thanks team. Leo/Pelorus, we'll run the enablement tomorrow and share the run notes + cost estimates.
Leo: Thanks all — appreciate the quick ops support.
OpsBot: Post-run checklist: export metrics -> /exports/pelorus/3200001111, send alert summary to #account-health.
